artwork_brief.text: Storm-cut north Atlantic chalk-and-rust-shale coast at LOW TIDE. Tall asymmetric cliff mass on RIGHT with two distinct accessible side-elevation strata and one vertical fissure/ladder link, a very wide mostly EMPTY open-air central void, and an exposed LEFT intertidal rock shelf with connected upper-and-lower traversable routes. Uneven seaweed beds, tiny pools and salt spray concentrated at the LOWER LEFT, not a large scenic ocean covering gameplay. A purposefully narrow high path above an accessible but hazardous-looking tidal low route; ledges, ramps and landings actually join solid ground. Cool fog-white chalk, charcoal shale, copper-rust bands and subdued kelp green. No lighthouse, fortress, heroic bridge or perspective.
